title: 2017 AMC 10B Problem 15
statement: Rectangle \(ABCD\) has \(AB=3\) and \(BC=4.\) Point \(E\) is the foot of the perpendicular from \(B\) to diagonal \(\overline{AC}.\) What is the area of \(\triangle ADE?\)

solutions.text:
The area of \(\triangle CDA\) is \(\dfrac{3\cdot4}{2}=6\). Since \(E\) lies on \(AC\), triangles \(EAD\) and \(CDA\) share the same altitude from \(D\), so \([EAD]=[CDA]\cdot \dfrac{AE}{AC}\).

By the Pythagorean Theorem, \(AC=5\). Also \(\triangle ABE\sim \triangle ACB\), so \(\dfrac{AE}{AB}=\dfrac{AB}{AC}=\dfrac35\), giving \(AE=\dfrac95\). Thus \(\dfrac{AE}{AC}=\dfrac{9}{25}\).

Therefore \([EAD]=6\cdot \dfrac{9}{25}=\dfrac{54}{25}\). Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Use similarity between \(\triangle ABE\) and \(\triangle ACB\)
Then compare \(\triangle EAD\) to \(\triangle CDA\) using their bases on \(AC\)
